akhfash:1-1.t: He said ﴿صۤ وَٱلْقُرْآنِ ذِي ٱلذِّكْرِ﴾: they claim that the place of the oath('s answer) is in His word ﴿إِن كُلٌّ إِلاَّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرٌّسُلَ﴾.

akhfash:3-3.t:
And He said ﴿وَّلاَتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ﴾: they likened ﴿لاتَ﴾ to ﴿ليسَ﴾ and implied in it the noun of the agent (i.e. its subject). ﴿لاتَ﴾ only occurs with "حِين" (time). Some read ﴿وَلاتَ حينُ مناصٍ﴾ in the nominative, making it in his reading like ﴿ليسَ﴾, as though he said "there is no one", and implied the khabar (predicate). In poetry [in the khafīf metre; this is poetic witness no. 264]:
طَلَبُوا صُلْحَنَا وَلاَتَ أَوَانٍ * فَأجَبْنَا أَنْ لَيْسَ حينُ بقاءِ
(They sought peace with us when it was no time for it, and we answered that it was no time for sparing.)
He put "أَوانٍ" in the genitive: he omitted and implied "الحين" and annexed it to "أَوانٍ", because ﴿لاتَ﴾ occurs only with "الحين".

akhfash:5-5.t: And He said ﴿أَجَعَلَ ٱلآلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهاً وَاحِداً﴾, just as you say: "اَتَجْعَلُ مِئةَ شاهدٍ شاهداً واحداً" (would you make a hundred witnesses a single witness?).

akhfash:33-33.t: [And] He said ﴿فَطَفِقَ مَسْحاً﴾, i.e. he stroked with a stroking.

akhfash:36-36.t: And He said ﴿رُخَآءً﴾: the accusative of ﴿رُخاءً﴾ is — and Allah knows best — on the basis of "We made it gentle with a gentleness".
